25: # tmux
26: 
27: Use for existing interactive tmux sessions. For one-shot commands, use normal shell. For new non-interactive background jobs, use background execution.
28: 
29: ## Basics
30: 
31: ```bash
32: tmux ls
33: tmux list-windows -t shared
34: tmux list-panes -t shared:0
35: tmux capture-pane -t shared:0.0 -p
36: tmux capture-pane -t shared:0.0 -p -S -
37: ```
38: 
39: Target format: `session:window.pane`, e.g. `shared:0.0`.
40: 
41: ## Send input
42: 
43: Literal text, then Enter:
44: 
45: ```bash
46: tmux send-keys -t shared:0.0 -l -- "Please continue"
47: tmux send-keys -t shared:0.0 Enter
48: ```
49: 
50: Special keys:
51: 
52: ```bash
53: tmux send-keys -t shared:0.0 C-c
54: tmux send-keys -t shared:0.0 C-d
55: tmux send-keys -t shared:0.0 Escape
56: ```
57: 
58: Use `-l --` for arbitrary text. Split text and Enter to avoid paste/newline surprises.
59: 
60: ## Sessions
61: 
62: ```bash
63: tmux new-session -d -s worker
64: tmux rename-session -t old new
65: tmux kill-session -t worker
66: ```
67: 
68: ## Prompt checks
69: 
70: ```bash
71: tmux capture-pane -t worker-3 -p | tail -20
72: tmux capture-pane -t worker-3 -p | rg "proceed|permission|Yes|No|❯"
73: ```
74: 
75: Approve/select only when the prompt is understood:
76: 
77: ```bash
78: tmux send-keys -t worker-3 -l -- "y"
79: tmux send-keys -t worker-3 Enter
80: ```

83:

85: - `scripts/wait-for-text.sh`: wait until pane output contains text.
